For a 2-bedroom flat in Hyderabad, I’d shortlist these three:

Asian Paints Beautiful Homes — More structured, brand-backed service with site evaluation, colour consultation, supervision and product/service warranty. A ₹250 inspection fee is refundable. Best if you prioritise process and accountability; final quote is after inspection. 
Asian Paints
+1

Urban Company Painting — Convenient app-based booking with multiple paint brands including Asian Paints, Berger and Dulux. Listed rates currently start around ₹8–₹26/sq ft for some Asian Paints options, but your final cost depends on area, prep and paint selected. 
Urban Company

AapkaPainter — Hyderabad-based painting specialist with 1,500+ reviews on the local listing. More focused on painting execution than a paint-manufacturer ecosystem; worth getting a project-specific quote.

Key difference: Asian Paints = structured/warranty-led; Urban Company = convenience and easy comparison; AapkaPainter = specialised local painting provider.

For a typical 2BHK, don’t compare only ₹/sq ft—ask each for the same scope: crack/putty work, number of coats, primer, ceilings, doors/grills, material brand, labour, cleanup and warranty.

For a 50-person Indian company, three suitable options are:

ITILITE — India-built, software-first travel + expense platform. Travel has no subscription/minimum commitment; you pay per booking. Includes 24/7 support, policy controls, approvals and GST reporting. Good for a self-service, tech-led programme. 
Itilite
+1

FCM Travel India — Full-service TMC with local teams, 24/7 emergency assistance and corporate air/hotel programmes. Its global hotel programme advertises up to 38% savings and 80,000+ prepaid Indian hotels. Better suited if travellers need substantial human support or international coverage. 
FCM Travel
+1

American Express Global Business Travel (Amex GBT) — Enterprise-oriented TMC combining booking, negotiated supplier programmes and duty-of-care infrastructure. Pricing is generally custom/contract-based, so request a transaction/management-fee quote. Amex also offers centralized corporate travel billing in India. 
americanexpress.com
+1

Key comparison: ITILITE emphasizes transparent, usage-based technology; FCM emphasizes locally delivered managed service; Amex GBT emphasizes enterprise-scale global programme management.

Provider	Total cost	Cancellation / returns	Support & availability
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Custom service fee + travel cost + GST; 1.5% payment-gateway fee can apply to certain card/wallet repayments.

Thomas Cook

FCM Travel India	Custom managed-service quote; ask for per-transaction + management fees.	Supplier charges can reach 100% of booking cost; reissue/change fees may apply.

What I’d request in the RFQ: all-in fee per booking, monthly minimums, credit period, cancellation/reissue fees, unused-ticket refunds, 24×7 SLA, implementation cost and GST reconciliation.

For a 50-person company, don't compare only the booking fee. Ask all three to price the same hypothetical monthly travel volume so the quotes are genuinely comparable.
